meta.title: Business Watchdog — payment monitoring for online stores
meta.description: We check the customer path to payment, watch real payment attempts and reconcile money with your payment provider. We tell you when customers stop paying successfully.

hero.title: Find out that payments broke before your customers do
hero.lead: Business Watchdog watches the customer path to the payment form, real payment attempts and whether the money arrived. When something stops working, you get an e-mail saying what happened and what to check.

features.title: What we check
features.checkout_body: Every 15 minutes a browser walks product → cart → checkout → payment form. It never places an order or charges money.
features.attempts_body: The plugin sees the outcome of every payment attempt per payment method. Several failures in a row and you will know.
features.money_body: With Stripe or PayPal connected we reconcile paid orders and refunds with real captures.
features.data_body: If the plugin goes quiet or a source is not connected, we say so. Missing data never looks like "all fine".

limits.title: What we do not promise
limits.body: We cannot guarantee that every purchase goes through: only a real payment can prove that. We tell you when customers stop paying successfully or the payment page stops working.
